## Repeated sampling

repeatedly draw random samples of the same size from a population. compute the mean for each sample --> distribution of sample means converges to a normal distribution 

We simulate this on a computer 

Basic idea of simulations is to generate repeated samples under a process you design --> check things are working the way they are supposed to 

* define a data generating mechanism (eg. normal distribution)
* draw a random sample from that data generating mechanism 
* analyze the sample (eg. compute sample mean)
* repeat 
* understand the analysis approach under repeated sampling 

Simulations are natural in the context of iteration 

write a function to

* define data generating mechanism 
* draw a sample 
* analyze the sample 
* return object of interest
* use a loop to analyze this many times 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(1)
```
